command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(whoami)" = ai-core-node; H=$(hostname); case "$H" in ai-core-node|ai-core-node-projekt-frankenstein) ;; *) echo "wrong host:$H" >&2; exit 41;; esac; VUNIT=frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service; CUNIT=frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service; VFINAL=/home/ai-core-node/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts/voice_final_runtime.py; CFINAL=/home/ai-core-node/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts/voice_host_777_live_client.py; OMEGA=/home/ai-core-node/.local/bin/omega; VCFG=$(systemctl --user show "$VUNIT" -p ExecStart --value); CCFG=$(systemctl --user show "$CUNIT" -p ExecStart --value); case "$VCFG" in *"$VFINAL"*) ;; *) echo "Voice not bound to final runtime: $VCFG" >&2; exit 61;; esac; case "$CCFG" in *"$CFINAL"*) ;; *) echo "Client not bound to final runtime: $CCFG" >&2; exit 62;; esac; for f in "$VFINAL" /home/ai-core-node/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts/voice_full_runtime.py /home/ai-core-node/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts/omega_runtime.py /home/ai-core-node/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts/frankenstein_identity_assembly.py "$CFINAL"; do test -f "$f"; python3 -m py_compile "$f"; done; echo '===PRE_SELFTEST==='; "$OMEGA" selftest; VPID0=$(systemctl --user show "$VUNIT" -p MainPID --value); CPID0=$(systemctl --user show "$CUNIT" -p MainPID --value); VSTART0=$(systemctl --user show "$VUNIT" -p ExecMainStartTimestamp --value); CSTART0=$(systemctl --user show "$CUNIT" -p ExecMainStartTimestamp --value); echo "PRE VOICE_PID=$VPID0 VOICE_START=$VSTART0 CLIENT_PID=$CPID0 CLIENT_START=$CSTART0"; echo '===CONTROLLED_RESTART==='; systemctl --user restart "$CUNIT"; systemctl --user restart "$VUNIT"; ok=0; for i in $(seq 1 30); do if systemctl --user is-active --quiet "$VUNIT" && systemctl --user is-active --quiet "$CUNIT"; then ok=1; break; fi; sleep 0.5; done; test "$ok" = 1; VPID1=$(systemctl --user show "$VUNIT" -p MainPID --value); CPID1=$(systemctl --user show "$CUNIT" -p MainPID --value); test "$VPID1" -gt 1; test "$CPID1" -gt 1; test "$VPID1" != "$VPID0"; test "$CPID1" != "$CPID0"; VCMD=$(tr '\0' ' ' < "/proc/$VPID1/cmdline"); CCMD=$(tr '\0' ' ' < "/proc/$CPID1/cmdline"); echo "VOICE_CMDLINE=$VCMD"; echo "CLIENT_CMDLINE=$CCMD"; case "$VCMD" in *"$VFINAL"*) ;; *) echo 'running Voice PID is not final runtime' >&2; exit 63;; esac; case "$CCMD" in *"$CFINAL"*) ;; *) echo 'running Client PID is not final runtime' >&2; exit 64;; esac; sleep 5; test "$(systemctl --user show "$VUNIT" -p MainPID --value)" = "$VPID1"; test "$(systemctl --user show "$CUNIT" -p MainPID --value)" = "$CPID1"; systemctl --user is-active --quiet "$VUNIT"; systemctl --user is-active --quiet "$CUNIT"; echo '===POST_SELFTEST==='; "$OMEGA" selftest; echo '===POST_STATUS==='; "$OMEGA" status; echo '===SERVICE_READBACK==='; systemctl --user show "$VUNIT" -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p ExecMainStatus -p MainPID -p ExecMainStartTimestamp -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p NRestarts -p ExecStart --no-pager; systemctl --user show "$CUNIT" -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p ExecMainStatus -p MainPID -p ExecMainStartTimestamp -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p NRestarts -p ExecStart --no-pager; echo "POST VOICE_PID=$VPID1 CLIENT_PID=$CPID1"; echo '===VOICE_JOURNAL_TAIL==='; journalctl --user -u "$VUNIT" -n 25 --no-pager || true; echo '===CLIENT_JOURNAL_TAIL==='; journalctl --user -u "$CUNIT" -n 25 --no-pager || true; echo OMEGA_RUNTIME_CREDIT_PASS
